en-US.author: Herdr, Inc.
en-US.description: A terminal runtime for coding agents: hc runs programs in terminals that stay alive, lets agents start and steer other agents, and lets you attach to any of them.
en-US.installationNotes: On Windows, templates and quoted shell commands need `sh` on PATH, such as Git for Windows provides.
en-US.longDescription:
herdr-core (`hc`) runs programs and coding agents in terminals that stay alive after you leave. Agents can start other agents, send them work, and hear back; you can attach to any terminal and take over. Core draws nothing, so use it from your shell, an agent, or your own app.
Every program runs in a terminal that lives in herdr-core, not in a window. Close the app, quit your terminal, or update either one: the program keeps going, and you attach to it again where it left off with `hc run`, `hc ls`, `hc attach`, and `hc read`. Helpers live under the agent that started them, report back when they are done, and stop when it stops.
Add a server, a VM, or another laptop over SSH and its terminals join the same list, so you run things there the same way. A terminal's status (working, done, needs you) is what its program reports through OSC 7501, the open Program Status Protocol; nothing is scraped or guessed. `hc schema` prints the API as OpenRPC, with streams and events for live updates, so a phone app, an editor panel, or a Stream Deck can be built on the same runtime the Herdr app uses.
en-US.name: herdr-core

zh-CN.description: 面向编程智能体的终端运行时：hc 在始终保持存活的终端中运行程序，让智能体启动并引导其他智能体，你也可以随时附加到任意终端并接管。
zh-CN.installationNotes: 在 Windows 上，模板与带引号的 shell 命令需要 PATH 中存在 `sh`，例如由 Git for Windows 提供。
zh-CN.longDescription:
herdr-core（`hc`）在离开后依然保持存活的终端中运行程序与编程智能体。智能体可以启动其他智能体、向它们分派工作并接收回报；你可以附加到任意终端并接管。Core 不绘制任何界面，可从 shell、智能体或你自己的应用调用。
每个程序都运行在 herdr-core 内部的终端里，而不是某个窗口中。关闭应用、退出终端或更新其中任意一个，程序都会继续运行，你可以通过 `hc run`、`hc ls`、`hc attach` 和 `hc read` 在原处重新接上。由某个智能体启动的助手归属于它，在完成时回报，并在它停止时一并停止。
通过 SSH 添加服务器、虚拟机或其他笔记本，它们的终端会加入同一个列表，你可以用相同方式在那里运行程序。终端的状态（working、done、needs you）由程序自身通过 OSC 7501（开放的 Program Status Protocol）上报，不做屏幕抓取或猜测。`hc schema` 以 OpenRPC 输出该 API，并提供 streams 与 events 用于实时更新，因此手机应用、编辑器面板或 Stream Deck 都能构建在 Herdr 应用所用的同一运行时之上。
